pages.text: $(bold)A tourist has four numbers$()$(br2)Three Values (Satisfaction, Magic, Wonder): The three icons shown in the top-left of a building — green is satisfaction, blue is magic and yellow is wonder. They increase as tourists intera
ct with buildings. When all three are maxed out, town experience increases, a$(br2)nd special tourists leave resumes.
$(li)Wallet: Affects purchase quantity in shops, directly impacting town revenue.$(li)Lodging: Affects maximum days stayed.$(li)Energy: Affects the number of buildings visited.

Tourists interact at building interact spots. If a spot is in use, tourists queue up.$(br2)At night, tourists seek hotels. If no room is available, they leave town.$(br2)Right-click a tourist to view the above information.
